_comment: Hestia governance hooks for the Google Antigravity CLI (agy). agy reuses the ~/.gemini tree; hooks live in ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json (or a plugin staged under ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/plugins/<name>/hooks.json). Merge this into that file. INVERTED vs gemini-cli: the PreToolUse gate emits a STDOUT decision object {"decision":"allow"|"deny","reason":...} and agy FAILS CLOSED (a hook that errors / exits non-zero = DENY, blocking every tool call - manaflow-ai/cmux #4768/#5358). So the gate emits an explicit clean verdict on both paths and stays robust+fast so it never spuriously blocks. It covers run_shell_command + write_file/replace + web_fetch/google_web_search (egress) + MCP calls; local read-class tools skip the governor. observe/hydrate emit {} and only wire to non-blocking events. HARDENING: put scripts on ext4 (agy self-updates; a slow 9p hook can block since deny is the failure mode), install at user level, repoint the /mnt/c paths per install. DOCUMENTED-tier: closed-source harness, tool/arg names assumed gemini-shaped - live-verify that normal agy events ALLOW cleanly (an over-strict guess BLOCKS work here, it does not fail safe).
